author: GameSpot
description:
Tune in on Thursday, September 3rd at 6am PT / 9am ET for two State of Play broadcasts airing back-to-back.

Firstly the State of Play will feature updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Right after the State of Play ends tune in for a new episode of State of Play Japan, which will be hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will showcase upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, news and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

description:
Onimusha: Way of the Sword, despite featuring an uninspired semi-open-world that doesn't justify its existence, is still a fantastic and welcome return for the series, led by outstanding combat that firmly places it in the upper echelon of modern action games.

author: GameSpot
description:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is an incredibly ambitious, deeply interesting first game from Rebel Wolves. Not every good idea lands and not every envelope is pushed as far as it could be, but the potential of the game is vast, and there's a huge amount to lean into and love. And it's all bolstered by excellent writing that makes for one of the deepest and most interesting game worlds I've run across in some time. The Blood of Dawnwalker is the kind of RPG that feels great to get lost in, that digs into your mind and stays there, and which is worth scouring and savoring.
